data.name: gspc-axes.csv
data.description:
Notebook-ready table with one row per declared measurement axis and 16 documented result, scope and source-bank columns.

## Column guide

| Column | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `axis` | Stable measurement axis identifier; one CSV row represents one declared axis. |
| `family` | Group of related axes, as published by the source board. |
| `kind` | Evidence type: model-comparison, deterministic-facts or declared-slot. Do not pool these types into one score. |
| `bench` | Source benchmark or method label for this axis, where provided. |
| `task` | Source task description or identifier for the recorded measurement. |
| `n` | Published count for this axis. Its unit depends on the method; absent is not zero. |
| `status` | Measurement state. MEASURED means evidence exists; UNMEASURED is an explicit coverage gap. |
| `separation` | Statistical separation result when applicable. TIE and UNTESTED do not establish a separated winner. |
| `public_leader_state` | Whether a leader can be displayed. SHOWN, NO_SIGNED_CARD and EXCLUDED_OWN_MODEL are display states, not scores. |
| `leader` | Displayable leader identifier, when available. A displayed leader does not establish a statistically separated win. |
| `accuracy` | Source accuracy for a model comparison, where provided. Missing or inapplicable values are not zero; inspect the method and separation state. |
| `fleet_mean` | Mean result over the recorded model fleet, where provided. It does not apply to deterministic fact axes. |
| `dataset` | Hugging Face identifier of the source dataset, when one is declared. |
| `dataset_url` | URL of the source dataset, when available. |
| `bank_state` | Observed availability of the declared evidence bank at capture time. A missing items.jsonl file does not imply zero evidence. |
| `bank_rows` | Observed evidence-bank rows, excluding canary-only records when counted. Missing values are not zero. |

Keep model comparisons separate from deterministic facts. TIE and UNTESTED are not separated wins. Record this dataset version and the capture time from SNAPSHOT.json.
